parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=4, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.06, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 hit 1.033232. While the team is exploring DEPTH=6, I'm seeing significant improvements at lower depth by tuning the LR and width. Next, I'll try decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to see if the lower LR trend scales here.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 to investigate if the lower learning rate trend seen in DEPTH=6 models also improves stability and convergence for DEPTH=4 models.
